steps.en: Use the recommended Docker image, or let uv build the env from uv.lock
steps.zh: 用推荐的 Docker 镜像，或让 uv 按 uv.lock 建环境

steps.en: Convert your dataset to parquet with the fields the reward needs
steps.zh: 把数据集转成带奖励所需字段的 parquet

steps.en: Launch the trainer with overrides for data, model, rollout engine and GPUs
steps.zh: 启动训练器，覆盖数据、模型、生成引擎和 GPU 配置

steps.en: Starts Ray and places actor, rollout, reference and critic workers on GPUs
steps.zh: 拉起 Ray，把演员、生成、参考、评论家工作进程放到 GPU 上

steps.en: vLLM or SGLang generates answers; your reward scores them; advantages computed
steps.zh: vLLM 或 SGLang 生成回答，你的奖励打分，算出优势

steps.en: FSDP or Megatron updates the actor, reshards weights to the rollout engine, checkpoints
steps.zh: FSDP 或 Megatron 更新演员，权重重分片回生成引擎并存档

value.en: An RL run whose generation and training engines share or split GPUs efficiently, with no weight-sync glue to write
value.zh: 一次生成与训练高效共用或分用 GPU 的 RL 训练，不用自己写权重同步胶水

sources: docs/start/quickstart.rst @ 2026-10-08: Docker image recommended; 'UV_RUN="uv run --frozen --all-packages --extra vllm --extra fsdp"'; 'python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k.py --local_save_dir ~/data/gsm8k'; 'python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo' with data.*, actor_rollout_ref.model.path, 'actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm', trainer.n_gpus_per_node, trainer.save_freq; GPU with at least 24 GB
